Marta (RevOps): Heads-up — Helios Diagnostics asked for a custom pilot pricing + extended payment terms. They want 45% off hosted API for 90 days and net60 invoices.
Ethan F.: What's the deal size and ask origin? Need ARR estimate, committed tokens, and whether this is coming from procurement.
Marta (RevOps): Initial pilot value ~ $18k over 3 months, expected to convert to $55k ARR if successful. Procurement requested net60 to align with their billing cycles.
Priya CSM: They are a healthcare customer, strict procurement. They asked for discount because they need to budget across multiple vendors. Also asked to waive onboarding fee.
Noel (Finance): 45% is beyond my approval; Finance can approve up to 25% for pilots under $50k if they prepay 30% or provide a PO. Net60 is higher risk — need credit review.
Sam R-Ops: RevOps can create a temporary pilot SKU but we need Finance sign-off for bigger concessions. Also note billing systems require a credit hold rule if PO is net60.
Jules (Legal): Legal will require a clause that pilot pricing is conditional and reverts to standard rates after the period. For healthcare customers, we also need data handling addendum and standard IP/usage clauses. Net60 ok if Procurement provides a valid PO and exec signoff.
Ethan F.: Proposed path: offer 25% off + waive onboarding only if they sign a 6-month conversion commitment (or pay 50% upfront), and accept net30. If Procurement insists on net60, escalate to Director of Finance.
Marta (RevOps): I can propose: TEMP_SKU: HELIOS_PILOT_90D, unit price $0.0056/1k tokens (25% off), setup waived if 20+ onboarding hours are billed to them or covered via paid professional services. PO required.
Noel (Finance): Conditional approval: up to 30% if they prepay 50% and sign conversion clause for 6 months. Anything >30% requires Director-level approval and credit check for net60.
Priya CSM: I'll confirm onboarding hours and ask Procurement for PO. I'll also check whether they can prepay part of the pilot.
Sam R-Ops: Opening ticket RDW-5033 to create HELIOS_PILOT_90D SKU and draft a credit memo template if required.
ops-bot: RDW-5033 created and assigned to Sam R-Ops.
Jules (Legal): I'll draft the pilot amendment and data addendum. Expect draft by EOD tomorrow.
Marta (RevOps): Great — Sales will push for PO + partial prepay. Will update once we have PO attached.
